name: webflow-anakin
description: Webflow Data Client (OAuth app): lets a site owner pick a CMS collection and a source URL, scrapes the URL with Anakin (generateJson), and writes the extracted structured data into a new Webflow CMS collection item via the Data API v2. Also exposes Anakin's map/crawl/Wire/AI Visibility/sessions/monitors APIs for site discovery, bulk import, and change tracking.
